title: Firing up the Lunar New Year spirit: All you need to know
summary: Why are red and gold so prominent for the Lunar New Year? Why is it the year of the Fire Horse? How, and where, is this holiday celebrated in France? And how big is the Asian diaspora in France? In this edition of Entre Nous, we're taking a deep dive into "Le Nouvel An Chinois" or the Chinese New Year, otherwise known as the Spring Festival, Farmer's Calend…
